breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the standard flexure formula σ = -My/I, which produces a linear stress distribution. It correctly identifies that at the neutral axis (y = 0 mm) the stress will be zero, and computes stresses at the top and bottom fibers using y = +50 mm and y = -50 mm respectively. The incorrect instruction to treat bending stress as uniform over the section depth has been removed entirely.
